text:
Anna: heads-up — after the autoscaler rollout last night we saw a p95 latency spike on model-x-small correlated with warmup events. anyone looking into warmers?

perf-bot: Autoscaler warmers triggered (region: us-east-1, eu-west-1). 1,220 synthetic requests sent to model-x-small between 2026-03-12T02:10Z and 02:15Z. Logs: /var/log/warmers/2026-03-12.log

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026.3.12-autoscaler-rollout succeeded, warmers enabled = true :rocket:

Josh: I pulled traces. cold KV cache miss rate jumped from ~8% baseline to ~42% during the warmers window. Also saw average batch size drop from 16 -> 9 which changes kernel selection (we fall back to generic kernel path for mixed batch shapes) — adds ~6–8ms/token.

Kai: hmm that's odd. warmers should increase hit rate. Are the synthetic requests matching real prefixes?

Anna: they do not. the warmers generator appends randomized suffix tokens to common prompts to vary decoding paths. that randomness is killing cache reuse because our cache key includes the whole prompt string.

Josh: here's the cache key code we currently use:
```python
def cache_key(model, prompt, tokenizer_id):
    return f\"{model}:{tokenizer_id}:{prompt}\"
```
so any tiny suffix change makes new entries.

Maya: that explains it. we should canonicalize and switch to prefix-based keying. proposal: compute a prefix-hash and store keys by (model, prefix_hash, quant_profile). warmers should sample from top prefixes seen in telemetry rather than random suffixing.

Kai: also saw a kernel selection regression in the traces. when KV is cold, the runtime underestimates effective sequence reuse and picks the streaming-optimized kernel which has worse throughput for the larger seq lengths we saw. numbers from perf run:
- cold: p50 18ms/token, p95 34ms/token
- warm: p50 12ms/token, p95 22ms/token
So KV miss -> smaller batches -> wrong kernel -> compounding slowdown.

Anna: proposed immediate actions:
- update warmers to reuse real prefixes from recent telemetry and stop random suffixing
- normalize prompts (trim/normalize whitespace, remove ephemeral request ids) before keying
- change cache key to prefix-hash + model + quant_profile
- add metric prewarm.kv_hit_rate and an alert if < 30% for 10m during warmers
- add a canary warm-up run in staging and compare p95 and kv_hit_rate before promoting

perf-bot: quick staging run with revised warmers (sampling top-200 prefixes) -> kv_hit_rate 72%, p95 improved ~18% vs previous warmers. logs: /var/log/warmers/staging-1769123600.log :white_check_mark:

Josh: I'll open PR to add canonicalize_prompt() and change the key function. will also add a short perf test under infra/perf/kv_warmers_test.py.

Maya: will update the autoscaler deployer config and add a scheduled nightly prewarm job scoped to top prefixes for each region. adding unit tests for cache key normalization and an e2e perf check.

Anna: great. @Josh @Maya please also add a note in the warmers runbook about "avoid synthetic suffix variation" and link to the perf traces. i'll follow up with a short doc on prefix selection heuristics (top-k by recent qps, weighted sampling). :eyes:
